body: Founder: i need a way to create dragonsnshit accounts for testing - i need iduna login i think it should live in iduna create account for dragonsnshit. Before this, every disposable test character across this session (including today's own KO-recovery and Home Point Crystal verification passes) was a raw SQLite INSERT straight into IDUNA's own characters table -- no real login, no real player row, nothing a human tester could actually sign into. New optional character_name (+ character_job) field on the existing POST /api/v1/auth/email/register endpoint -- the same real place a DragonsNShit-playing account is already created, not a second parallel test-account endpoint. When set, the same request that registers the player also inserts a real characters row (mmo.go's own handleCreateCharacter shape) in the same transaction, returning character_id/character_name alongside the real login credentials. Live-verified end-to-end against the real running services: register -> real character_id back; login -> real JWT; GET /api/v1/characters/:id with that JWT -> real character row; POST to apps2/mud's own /api/town/command with that exact character_id -> a real, live, playable character (Level 1, HP 90/90, Zone Meadow). Test account cleaned up after verification. Also found and fixed a real, separate operational issue while deploying: an orphaned iduna process from 2026-08-03 (PID 1774001, ppid=1, not tracked by systemd) was squatting on :8080, silently causing every systemd-managed restart to crash-loop on 'address already in use' while the stale binary kept serving all traffic -- meaning a real deploy of this exact fix would otherwise have silently never taken effect. Killed it; iduna.service now runs the current build under real supervision again. No sudo was actually needed (contrary to founder's own expectation) -- systemctl --user worked once XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS were exported with the correct real uid (1000, not the stale root-pointing default in this shell's env). go build ./IDUNA/... and go test ./IDUNA/... both clean. Commit e8645f3/34a5ee1.
title: Real DragonsNShit test-account creation, atomic in IDUNA's own register endpoint
